pest_break.note: Fix of spec B4.7 (see README): 100 x min(1, distinct families/3) x min(1, extra host-free years / 3). Host = today's main crop (Rice (medium grain, water-seeded)); extra host-free years = (longest circular stretch without the host - today's) / 365, so today's rotation scores 0 and the normal winter gap earns nothing. 3 years for a full break from UC IPM alfalfa ('a 3- to 4-year nonhost crop rotation is ideal'); range 2-4 years; using it for rice is our assumption (U); UC IPM rice (https://ipm.ucanr.edu/agriculture/rice/integrated-weed-management/) names cereals, safflower and dry fallow as rotations out of rice. Families ['Poaceae']; longest stretch without Rice (medium grain, water-seeded) 580 d vs 215 d today = 1.00 extra host-free years. No pest dataset exists. rule of thumb, not a model
